## Change and reason

Explain what changed, why it helps, and any related issue.

## Verification

Describe the checks actually performed and their results. State any checks that could not be completed. There are no application test commands at this planning stage.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and all repository-facing text is in English.
- [ ] Proposals, confirmed decisions, and completed work are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Relevant links, images, and formatting have been checked.
- [ ] No secrets, private information, or assets/data without appropriate usage rights are included.
- [ ] Any unresolved decisions are described; substantial code awaits licensing and implementation decisions.
